entry.title: ESA to pursue crew transport and space stations as European launchers come online
entry.summary: Illustration of The Exploration Company’s Nyx capsule approaching the ISS. (Credit: The Exploration Company) European crew transport Preparing for the decommissioning of the International Space Station (ISS), currently scheduled to begin in 2030, ESA and other ISS partners are working to ensure sustained access to low-Earth orbit. Ultimately, ESA wants a European version of all capabilities required for human spaceflight, including not only rockets and a crew vehicle but also a launch abort system, space operations, science, and crew recovery. ESA to pursue crew transport and space stations... 关键事实：ESA to pursue crew transport；space stations

entry.title: Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue Collaborative Combat Aircraft Has Flown
entry.summary: We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave, California today. Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue, which now has the official designation YFQ-48A, has taken to the skies for the first time. Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft. 关键事实：We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave；California today；Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue

entry.title: Raytheon awarded $24.4 billion multi-year contract for SM-6 interceptors
entry.summary: Raytheon has secured a five-year contract, with two additional option years, valued up to $24.4 billion for Standard Missile-6 (SM-6) interceptors, significantly increasing the availability of a critical munition able to conduct both offensive strikes and missile defense missions. “SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper. SM-6 is the only combat-proven weapon that can perform anti-air warfare, anti-surface warfare and ballistic missile defense. 关键事实：Raytheon has secured a five-year contract；with two additional option years；valued up to $24.4 billion for Standard Missile-6 (SM-6) interceptors

entry.title: North Korea launches ballistic missile after Seoul demands apology over wounded soldiers
entry.summary: Pyongyang fires towards sea a day after Kim Jong-un sister denounces South Korea for claiming North’s mines wounded South’s soldiers in DMZ North Korea fired a ballistic missile towards the sea on Saturday, South Korea and Japan said, ⁠a day ​after it rejected Seoul’s accusation of its mines wounding soldiers. The missile was launched from the Wonsan area at about 6.30am towards the East Sea – also known as the Sea of Japan – and flew more than 700km (434 miles), the South Korean military said. Seoul and Washington were analysing the test for details, it added. 关键事实：Pyongyang fires towards sea a day；⁠a day ​after it rejected Seoul’s accusation of its mines wounding soldiers

entry.title: AI giants 'not being nearly careful enough,' warns outgoing OpenAI safety engineer
entry.summary: A safety engineer who recently quit ChatGPTcreator OpenAI warned Saturday that artificial intelligence (AI) firms were "not being nearly careful enough."

entry.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
entry.summary: In an essay published in The Atlantic, Robinson said he led the writing of safety reports that accompanied OpenAI’s major product launches. He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI, he is “among the longest-tenured employees at the company.” Now he’s quitting, because in his view, the company’s “culture is broken.” But in Robinson’s view, the debate needs to go beyond “specific rules or new laws,” addressing the overall culture at these companies. 关键事实：In an essay published in The Atlantic；Robinson said he led the writing of safety reports that accompanied OpenAI’s major product launches；He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI
